title: Narrative Reward
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 40 participants engaged in an interactive narrative task involving decision-making and feedback processing. Participants read a story with hierarchically-blocked decision points where they evaluated items and received correctness feedback, with experimental manipulation of narrative context presence. The study examines neural correlates of reward processing and decision-making within narrative versus non-narrative conditions across three locations with nested sub-locations.
methods_description: EEG data were collected while participants performed an interactive narrative task. Participants made yes/no decisions about items presented with or without narrative context, and received feedback indicating correct or incorrect responses. Narrative context was provided hierarchically at location entry/exit points and before each sub-location. The experimental design included three locations, each containing three sub-locations with 6 items each.
